say:2:1321748001:1.text: Honorable guests, would you like to try making a doughman?
say:2:1321748001:1.source_cn: 各位大人，要来堆一个面团雪人吗？

say:3:1321748002:1.text: A doughman? Is that a custom here in Whiteridge?
say:3:1321748002:1.source_cn: 面团雪人？这是白山公国的习俗吗？

say:4:1321748003:1.text: Oh, I see you're Captain Rodrigo's guest! You must be unfamiliar with our customs.
say:4:1321748003:1.source_cn: 呀，您是罗德里戈大人的客人吧？难怪对公国的习俗不太了解。

say:5:1321748004:1.text: In our duchy, it snows all year, so we naturally build real snowmen. But the doughmen were something Miss Lydia came up with for the princess.
say:5:1321748004:1.source_cn: 公国境内常年积雪，大家自然会堆真正的雪人。用面团堆雪人...

say:6:1321748005:1.text: After her illness, the princess became quite sensitive to the cold. Since most of the Snowspire Festival's activities take place outside, we needed a cozy indoor alternative.
say:6:1321748005:1.source_cn: 殿下自从生病以后，就非常怕冷，但冬日祭典的活动几乎都要...

say:7:1321748006:1.text: The idea is simple. Take two dough balls, stack them to form a body, and decorate them. They look just like real snowmen, and the best part is that they won't melt!
say:7:1321748006:1.source_cn: 您瞧，用面团捏出两个圆球，摞在一起组成雪人的身子，再挑...

say:8:1321748007:1.text: Why don't you try making one too? You could create your own unique design that isn't already in the castle. I'm sure the princess will be so delighted when she sees it!
say:8:1321748007:1.source_cn: 你们也来做些面团雪人吧？最好是城堡里没有的造型，公主殿...
say:8:1321748007:1.male: Why don't you try making one too? You could create your own unique design that isn't already in the castle. I'm sure the princess will be so delighted when she sees it!
say:8:1321748007:1.female: Why don't you try making one too? You could create your own unique design that isn't already in the castle. I'm sure the princess will be so delighted when she sees it!

choice_prompt:9:1321748007.female: Why don't you try making one too? You could create your own unique design that isn't already in the castle. I'm sure the princess will be so delighted when she sees it!

narration:10:1321748008:0.text: With Stariva's help, you quickly shape two perfectly round dough balls.
narration:10:1321748008:0.source_cn: 在侍女的帮助下，你们很快捏好了两个圆滚滚的面团

say:11:1321748009:0.text: Oh my! This is so well-made! I had no idea you had such talent.
say:11:1321748009:0.source_cn: 哎呀，捏得真好！以前真没看出来两位大人还有这方面的天赋呢。

say:12:1321748010:1.text: Now, please head to the <style="highlight">guard</style> over there and choose some <style="highlight">decorations</style> for the doughman.
